a.text: You're looking that way again? At the Grand Knight Territory?
I know the Grand Knight Territory. That's where the powerful knight lords compete against each other, right?
You never stop talking about it, of course I know!
Hey, Justyna, you're really planning to go there?

I know you've been practicing whenever you don't have farm work. Everybody in the village knows you want to be a knight. You can fight off the bandits who come looking for trouble, they're no match for you.
But the Grand Knight Territory is pretty far... If you go, will you ever come back?
You will? Really? After you become a knight?
It's a promise then. We'll wait for you to come home, showered in glory, and then we'll spread the word that our town is the home of the Justyna, the knight!

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: No footprints, no tracks at all...

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: They didn't go this way.

steps.name: Armorless Union Captain
steps.text: The hospital team lost the target, they're bound to pass through here if they're trying to escape.

steps.name: Armorless Union Captain
steps.text: Stay alert. I want regular reports.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Armorless Union Assassin
steps.text: Guh... agh...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: They're going to know something's wrong. Come with me while there's still time.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I don't take orders from Infected.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Though I admit you have some skill, able to handle those lowlifes from that distance.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: But don't think that means I'm here to listen to you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: The Armorless have this whole place surrounded. You're not getting out of here alone.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: They're not going to give up the chase.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I'll make them pay for it.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: That's not going to be easy.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Your wounds haven't healed, how can you hide from them like this?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Ugh... damned Armorless.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: I'll go along with you for now, but only because we share a common enemy. I'll make those murderers pay for what they did!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: We'll talk about that later, we're still in danger here.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Don't think I have anything else to say to you later.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Listen girly, you've got a certain champion to thank for the fact that you're standing here, speaking to me in that armor.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You're not wrong.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: There was a time when I had bottomless gratitude for the Blood Knight.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Why so quiet?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Competition.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I watched you go up against Maria Nearl—'Plastic' Szewczyk.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I don't like you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You're slightly less obnoxious out on the field.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Your feelings don't matter, but watch the attitude. You should never have taken me out of the hospital.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It was Sona's idea. And anyway—

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: And anyway nothing. Sona is your leader's name? Hmph, sounds like another little girl.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: She's a friend.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll take you back to the base. Sona and my other friends are all waiting for us.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Make no mistake, I may have agreed to work with you for now, but I'm not part of your group, infected knight.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No, I'm very clear, you're not at all like us.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But, 'Plastic' Szewczyk, you must know, you have no hope of resisting the Armorless Union alone.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Heh... Sure, you're right about that.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: It's funny, Kazimierz as it is today. An Infected can be a knight, and a gang of thugs like the Armorless can roam about freely.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Funny...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Let's meet up with the others first.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: We won't get anything done by ourselves.
Ten days earlier...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Just who the hell are you people?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: There's no end to them...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Hiding in the crowd, are you?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Don't think I won't—
Wait! Don't do it!
Ah... looks like I'm a little late? How did this turn into such a warzone?
Not good. Not good at all.
Anyway, let's pick up the pace. Start evacuating people first.
That's all we can do.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Hey there, 'Fartooth' Knight, I still haven't had a chance to congratulate you on your title. Nice job there.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: I saw a piece on you. Popularity's through the roof, huh?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Announcing a new knightclub, getting real controversial, pushing that popularity up, hm? Hmph, looks like you've kicked a hornet's nest to me.

steps.name: A Strange Passerby
steps.text: Infected knights...

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: That's enough of that.

steps.name: A Strange Passerby
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Alright, anyway, the fight's fought, what's done is done. *Sigh*.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Flametail, and Ashlock... What are you doing here?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Do you know who these people are?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Like the back of my hand. But this isn't a good place for a chat... these guys are looking to make a scene, and the media will be here before long. That wouldn't end well for you.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: And anyway, you're probably hurt, right?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Just come with us, all nice and quiet-like, and we'll explain nice and slow what's going on. What do you say?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Do you have to say it like you're kidnapping her?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Huh? Did I?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: A little.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll go. I trust you.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Sorry, what?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Just take me along, wherever you're going. I trust you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I feel like...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: We're the same. I can trust you.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Where are we...?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Oh! That was fast. Your wounds all better?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Are all these people here Infected?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Sure are. Everyone who lives here is. Most got unlucky, got sick in an accident or something, lost their jobs and homes, ended up with nowhere to go.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Granted, the room and board here is a little rough, but... it's better than nothing, right?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Sona, Iwona's in trouble, I'll go see what I can do.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union is probably still active. I'll tell the others to be careful too.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Alright. Don't worry, I'm on it.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Right. You've got it.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: She...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Hm? Oh, you mean Ashley? She's a good girl. The way she talks is just a little too straight up sometimes.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: She hasn't said a word to me since we first met.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Ahaha! Ashley's a little shy with strangers too.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: *Sigh*. Well, alright...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Ashley just thinks you're too different from us, like you've walked a different path.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: I mean, you're a star of the Major, with a shiny new knight title, so hot right now!

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: No matter which way you look at it, you've got a bright future!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No... I don't.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: An Infected... an Infected knight... has no future.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: That doesn't sound like something a big competition winner would say.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I used to think that as long as I could be a knight, there was still hope. If I could win in the arena, maybe...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Maybe you could even earn some respect, be seen as a true knight, and win back the life you used to have?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Yes... That's what I thought.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But that's not how it works. An Infected knight is still Infected. And that's all that matters.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Yeah. That's pretty much what I've said to Ashley.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: And besides, so what if you're a knight? Just look what happened to you back there in that crowd. Those folks who jumped you didn't care if you're Infected or noble or whatever.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You were saying they're with the Armorless Union?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Knight-Assassins... the words feel gross in my mouth.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Yeah, that's them.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: They sell themselves to the General Chamber of Commerce, bumping off knights who don't play ball... They call themselves experts in handling knights, and wear that with pride.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: And add on the rewards, in cheers and treasure, that the audience heaps upon the knights, proper or not, how much dignity is left in the title? That's before you even talk about us.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: So me getting attacked this time, that was the K.G.C.C.'s orders?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Probably. You've got the spotlight on you, and you're turning down all the knightclub invitations, and talking like you do out there... sooner or later, you get a knock like that at your door.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: And if you won't be their goldmine, then they find you a 'dishonorable' exit, so you won't get in the way of their business.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: So you know, not that crazy you'd get attacked.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Two three-week periods.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: On my way to the Grand Knight Territory, I got infected.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: And since I was Infected, they wouldn't let me register as a knight. So I wandered around for three weeks with nowhere to stay.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It was during the third week that the Blood Knight won the Major.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Then, three weeks later, they opened the registration window for Infected knights.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I didn't have any money left on me, so I went to the black market ring, working up enough money to pay the registration fees.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: That... couldn't have been easy.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Underground knight sports for infected knights is pretty much the same as the black market.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: From the underground competitions to the Major, I've seen too many ridiculous things to be surprised anymore.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Haha! Fair enough. There's definitely stuff going on in the underground fights that tops whatever the Armorless Union can come up with.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: We've all been through stuff like that, more or less, and that's how we end up here.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: There sure are a lot of Infected here.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Right... how can I put it? You can make a lot in the knight competitions, at least enough to buy a place for these people who have nowhere else to go.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: So that means the money's still worth something, right?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Heh. Nice.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: You're easier to get along with than we might've thought. When I first bumped into you, I was worried you were all icy cold.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Oh? You got all quiet?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I just... I just don't know... I guess I don't know what to say at times like this.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Alright... I think I get it now. You and Ashley are both shy with strangers.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: And this habit of yours where you say half a thing up front, I think I'm getting used to it. Not that there's anything wrong with it, it's just tricky to follow sometimes.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Either way, thanks for helping me.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Ah, it was nothing. Don't sweat it.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: So anyway, where are you gonna go? If you pop right back out, they're gonna go after you again.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: That scuffle back there is gonna get reported soon. What do you think we'll see on the news?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No idea. Whatever they want.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Honestly... I don't know where I'd go. I haven't had anywhere to go for a long time.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Well, you may think I'm just throwing it out there to hold it over you, but this is an honest offer, out of the kindness of my heart.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: There's me, and Ashley, and Iwona, you've seen her, with the big loud mouth?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Yes, I know her.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: The truth is... we had the same idea as you, in your little statement about setting up an independent knightclub.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: I came up with the name already. Pinus Sylvestris. The Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, a club of our very own.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: And since you've got nowhere to go, Justyna, wouldn't you consider maybe joining us?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You're... inviting me?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Sure as sure can be. Can I spell it out any clearer for you?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Alright. I'm in.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: —Us... together.

a.text: Play your flute again, won't you? Whatever you want. Everyone loves hearing you play.
We won't get to hear that again for a long time. Everyone's gonna miss you.
Aren't you worried about going so far all alone? We know you get lonely, you're just too shy to admit it. Always sitting quietly off to the side.
You think the wind might carry your voice back home?
You're going to be a knight. We all believe you're going to be an amazing one, like that Radiant Knight you're so fond of.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Now that we're here, we're safe. Someone will meet us out front.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: How are your wounds?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Fine. Just a scratch, barely worth mentioning. But you Infected knights, you base yourselves here in the city? Not out in a village somewhere?

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: No one would allow the Infected to live within the city limits. Just what are you up to?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: When you've got money, you can do anything.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Hah... money. True enough. So long as you have money, you can do anything here.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: But if word gets out, you'll be arrested.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Anyone eager to open their mouth gets a word with my arrows first.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I won't allow anyone to harm the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Then lead the way. I can't stand the thought of the Armorless Union scum on the loose out there. I'm working against the General Chamber of Commerce now, so I need to move fast.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Show me to your Infected knight leader, who forced one of your strength to drag me out of the hospital against your will.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Not against my will.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It wasn't Sona who sent me to rescue you. It was my own choice. Not at all against my will.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: But how? I understand we have a mutual distaste for one another.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Or is this some kind of big picture play?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's just... you have a family.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: What are you talking about?!

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Those insects! They dare move against my boy?!

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Don't worry, Sona has eyes on him. The Armorless backed off. They didn't touch your son.

steps.name: Plastic Knight
steps.text: Then I must offer my thanks.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: You owe them to Sona. It was all her idea.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: As for me, my personal feelings towards you have nothing to do with whether or not I'll let you get hurt.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I just... your son...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Without you, he'd have nowhere to go.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Justyna the Knight has a home, with family and friends waiting for her.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: But Justyna the Infected doesn't.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: An Infected has nowhere to go.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: No, it's not just the Infected. Here, in this place, there are a lot more people with nowhere to go.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's too late for me. I can't go back.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: If the wind really can carry my voice home...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Then I'll have to ask it not to. Don't carry anything but the sound of my flute.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Let Justyna stay a simple, ordinary girl... dreaming of knighthood.
